(3) The boy walks across the room, transitioning from the carpet to a light-colored wooden floor. He heads toward a kitchen area with white cabinets and a dark refrigerator. A woman wearing a black t-shirt and light-blue jeans is seen standing at the stove. The boy approaches her and hugs her leg while looking up. (4) The final shot shows the boy looking up at the woman while she pats his head. He is still wearing the oversized cap, which is slightly tilted. The lighting is warm and domestic, suggesting an evening indoor setting.
